svg.title: Pokken database entity relationship diagram
svg.desc: The physical Oracle schema for Pokken, including twelve game tables, thirteen foreign keys, column types and nullability, and relationship cardinalities.
svg.text: 12 game tables and 13 foreign keys in the deployed Oracle schema
A combat has one history row per participant.
Move IDs link species and the details that describe each move class.
ENTRENADOR and COMBATE form a many-to-many relationship.
A species requires ataque1. Slots 2–4 are optional. Each filled slot points to one move.
PK Primary key FK Foreign key UQ Unique ID Identity (BY DEFAULT) * NOT NULL
Arrows point from the foreign key to the parent. Numbers beside the ends show the allowed matches per relationship.
The history PK combines id_entrenador and id_combate. The species PK is id_pokken. Its four move FKs restrict deletion.
All other FKs cascade on delete. Active triggers enforce stats 1–255, PP greater than 0, priority −7 to +5, and victory or defeat.
